description: This file defines the FormatDate class with a static method format for formatting dates using internationalization features, considering locale and timezone settings.

classes.name: FormatDate
classes.description: A utility class providing a static method to format date objects according to locale settings.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a given date using locale-specific formatting, with fallback to English locale and GMT timezone if the intl extension is not loaded.
